Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Grammar rules (Tenses) and QA Vocabulary. Use English Grammar in Use or Duolingo. Write down 5 new tech terms.

Subject: Eng: Listening & Shadowing
Description: Watch a short video (A2 level or tech tutorial). Practice Shadowing (repeat aloud). Focus on pronunciation.

Subject: Eng: Reading & Writing (QA focus)
Description: Read a short tech article or API doc. Write a sample bug report (Steps, Expected, Actual).

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Modals (should, can, must) and office vocabulary. Write 5 sentences using them.

Subject: Eng: Speaking (Active Practice)
Description: Speak out loud. Describe what you tested yesterday. Use AI Voice (ChatGPT/Claude) for a 15-min conversation.

Subject: Eng: Passive Listening (Relax)
Description: Watch an episode of 'The Office' or a tech podcast. Relax and just try to catch the context.

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Review past week's grammar. Focus on forming questions (How do you test this?).

Subject: Eng: Listening & Shadowing
Description: Shadowing practice with a QA-related video (e.g., 'What is a bug?').

Subject: Eng: Reading & Writing (QA focus)
Description: Write a test case for a login page in English. Use simple, clear sentences.

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Prepositions of place and time (in, on, at). Learn 5 terms related to UI testing.

Subject: Eng: Speaking (Active Practice)
Description: Simulate a 'Daily Standup'. Say: what you did yesterday, what you will do today, and if you have blockers.

Subject: Eng: Passive Listening (Relax)
Description: Watch a TV show in English with English subtitles.

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Present Continuous vs Present Simple. Vocabulary: Agile/Scrum terms.

Subject: Eng: Listening & Shadowing
Description: Listen to a short tutorial on Postman or API testing. Shadow the key phrases.

Subject: Eng: Reading & Writing (QA focus)
Description: Write a brief email to a 'developer' explaining a bug you found. Keep it polite and clear.

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Comparatives (faster, more efficient). Describe two testing tools.

Subject: Eng: Speaking (Active Practice)
Description: Record yourself explaining a simple testing concept (e.g., 'What is regression testing?') on your phone. Listen back.

Subject: Eng: Passive Listening (Relax)
Description: Watch a YouTube video on a topic you enjoy (not studying, just exposure).

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Review: Past Simple. Write down 5 things you did in your last project.

Subject: Eng: Listening & Shadowing
Description: Shadowing: Find a video of someone doing a mock interview. Repeat their answers.

Subject: Eng: Reading & Writing (QA focus)
Description: Start drafting your QA Resume/CV in English. Focus on the 'Summary' section today.

Subject: Eng: Grammar & Vocabulary
Description: Study: Future tenses (will vs going to). Plan your next week in English.

Subject: Eng: Speaking (Active Practice)
Description: Use AI Voice to practice answering: 'Tell me about yourself'. Focus on your QA background.

Subject: Eng: Passive Listening (Relax)
Description: Watch an episode of your favorite English series.
